q: How much does accommodation cost in Bihać?
a: With us, a whole property costs from 25 to 100 € per night, depending on size, season and facilities. You can get an entire apartment of up to 100 m² from just 25 €, or 50 KM, per night, while a single room in Bihać usually costs around 50 KM. You can see prices for your dates next to each property on apartmanibihac.com.

q: Is an apartment in Bihać cheaper than a hotel room?
a: Usually, yes: with us a whole apartment costs from 50 KM, or 25 €, per night, while a single room in Bihać typically costs around 50 KM. In other words, you get a whole apartment for the price of a room, with a kitchen, a living room and more space. The more of you there are, the bigger the saving per person.

q: How many properties do you have in Bihać?
a: At apartmanibihac.com we have 19 properties: seven apartments in Bihać and twelve houses and holiday cottages on the Una in Lohovo, Pritoka and Grmuša. They sleep from two to twenty people. All are booked directly, with no booking fee. Prices range from 25 to 100 € per night for the whole property, depending on the property and season.

q: Which apartments do you have in Bihać town centre?
a: In Bihać we offer Apartman Centar, Apartman City Centar, Apartman Hari, Apartman M. Mahala (Midžić Mahala), Farah Superior Apartments, Feel Luxury Apartments and LUX Apartments Bihać. They sleep from 2 + 1 up to 12 people, and from most of them you can walk to the riverside promenade. You can see the description and facilities of each apartment on apartmanibihac.com.

q: Which houses on the River Una do you have?
a: On the Una we offer the houses and cottages Green River, Vikendica Unadom, Vila Enio, Vikendica Rekić, the Japodska treehouse (Japodska kućica na drvetu), Vikend kuća Bašić, Vikend kuća Emira, Villa Džane, Vikendica Džane 2, Vikendica Karakaš, Villa Mekić and Villa Mekić 2. They are in Lohovo, Pritoka and Grmuša. Many have their own access to the river and a terrace.

q: Is it better to stay in Bihać town centre or in a house on the Una?
a: The centre is better for short stays, guests without a car and those who want restaurants and the promenade a few minutes' walk away. Houses on the Una are better for a holiday by the water, with swimming, barbecues and peace and quiet, but you will need a car for town and day trips. Many guests choose the centre for a weekend and a house for a week in summer.

q: What accommodation in Bihać do you recommend for a couple?
a: For a couple in town, Apartman Centar in the very centre is a good choice, sleeping 2 + 1, with a 200 x 200 cm bed and parking. If you want peace by the river, the Japodska treehouse sleeps up to four and has access to the Una. A whole apartment for two costs from 25 € per night with us, depending on the season.

q: Do you have accommodation in Bihać for a large group?
a: Yes, for large groups the biggest is Villa Mekić 2, sleeping up to 20 people in apartments, while in town Feel Luxury Apartments sleep up to 12 and LUX Apartments Bihać up to 10. On the Una there are Vikendica Karakaš for 9 + 1 and Villa Džane for up to 9 people. For team-building, sports teams and rafting groups, send an enquiry with the number of people.

q: What accommodation in Bihać do you recommend for a family with children?
a: For families in town, Apartman Hari, sleeping up to 4 with a terrace and washing machine, and Apartman M. Mahala (Midžić Mahala), sleeping 4 + 2 with two terraces and a barbecue, are practical choices. By the water there is Vila Enio in Lohovo, sleeping up to 6, with a swimming pool and access to the Una. At riverside houses, always supervise children when swimming.

q: Do you have an apartment with a cot?
a: Yes, at Apartman M. Mahala (Midžić Mahala) a cot is available on request. For other properties, just ask in your enquiry and we will check with the owner. In your message, mention your child's age and whether you need a cot or a high chair. Apartman M. Mahala sleeps 4 + 2 and has two terraces, so it works well for families.

q: Are there dog-friendly apartments in Bihać?
a: Yes, dogs are welcome at Apartman M. Mahala (Midžić Mahala). For other properties, just ask in your enquiry, as each owner sets their own pet policy. Please mention the size and number of your pets. Apartman M. Mahala has two outdoor terraces, a barbecue and free parking, and the riverside promenade is close by for longer dog walks.

q: Do you have accommodation with a barbecue?
a: Yes, Apartman M. Mahala (Midžić Mahala) has a barbecue and two outdoor terraces, which is rare for accommodation in town. For the houses on the Una, ask in your enquiry and we will check with the owner whether a barbecue is available. In summer, a barbecue by the river is one of the main reasons guests choose a holiday house.

q: Do you have accommodation with bike storage?
a: Yes, Apartman M. Mahala (Midžić Mahala) has space for bicycles, making it a good choice for cyclists and motorcyclists. For other properties, ask in your enquiry and the owner will tell you whether there is covered or lockable storage. Bihać and the Una valley are popular for cycling.

q: Do you have accommodation with a swimming pool in Bihać?
a: Yes, Vila Enio in Lohovo has a swimming pool, a poolside terrace and access to the Una, and sleeps up to 6. Lohovo is a quiet village on the Una about 10 km south of Bihać town centre. Vila Enio is one of our most popular properties in summer, so book early.

q: Do you have a house with direct access to the River Una?
a: Yes, most of our houses and cottages have their own access to the Una, including Green River, Vikendica Unadom, Vikendica Rekić, Villa Džane and Vikendica Karakaš. Some have a terrace right over the river. The description of each property on apartmanibihac.com says whether it has access to the water.

q: Where should I stay in Bihać for rafting?
a: For rafting, Grmuša is the most practical, about 20 km from Bihać, where Una Olympic Rafting has its base. Here you will find Green River and Vikendica Unadom, both sleeping 6 + 2, with access to the Una and a terrace over the river. You can ask for accommodation and rafting in the same enquiry.

q: What is the Japodska treehouse?
a: The Japodska treehouse (Japodska kućica na drvetu) is a small holiday house by the Una for up to four people, with a terrace, a seating area underneath and access to the river. It has a TV, Wi-Fi and free parking. It suits couples and small families who want to sleep in nature while staying close to Bihać.

q: Do you have accommodation in Bihać for a long stay?
a: Yes, for longer stays apartments with a kitchen and washing machine work well, such as Apartman Hari, Apartman M. Mahala (Midžić Mahala) or Feel Luxury Apartments. For a week or a month, ask for a price in your enquiry, as owners often offer a better rate for longer stays. Send your enquiry at apartmanibihac.com or on WhatsApp +387 61 591 320.

q: Do you have accommodation in Bihać for business trips?
a: Yes, for business stays in town, Apartman Centar, Apartman City Centar and LUX Apartments Bihać are a good fit, with Wi-Fi, a kitchen and parking. From the centre you can walk to offices, banks and restaurants. If you need an invoice for your company, mention it in your enquiry before confirmation.

q: Is bed linen included in the price?
a: Yes, bed linen is included in the price at all our properties, and the beds are made up when you arrive. Final cleaning is also included, so you do not pay for it separately. For the riverside houses it is a good idea to bring your own towels for swimming in the Una; check other facilities in the property description or ask when you enquire.

q: Is there Wi-Fi in the accommodation?
a: Almost all our properties have Wi-Fi, as stated in each property's description on apartmanibihac.com. In riverside houses outside town, the connection may be slower than in the centre. If you need a stable connection for work, mention it in your enquiry. Your host will give you the Wi-Fi password on arrival.

q: Do the apartments have air conditioning?
a: Air conditioning is available at, for example, Apartman M. Mahala (Midžić Mahala), Farah Superior Apartments, Feel Luxury Apartments and LUX Apartments Bihać. Summer temperatures can go above 30 °C, so air conditioning is useful in town. For other properties, check the description or ask in your enquiry. Houses on the Una are usually a little cooler in summer than apartments in town, thanks to the river.

q: Does the accommodation have a kitchen?
a: Yes, all our apartments and houses have a kitchen or kitchenette, so you can cook your own meals. Some also have a dishwasher, oven and coffee machine, for example Feel Luxury Apartments and LUX Apartments Bihać. You can see the exact facilities in the property description. Groceries are easy to buy in Bihać, and for houses outside town it is best to shop before you arrive.

q: Does the accommodation have parking?
a: Yes, most of our properties have parking on site, and at some it is explicitly free, for example at Apartman Hari, Apartman M. Mahala (Midžić Mahala) and Feel Luxury Apartments. Each property description says whether parking is available. If you are coming with several cars or a van, mention it in your enquiry.

q: Is there a tourist tax in Bihać?
a: Yes, in the Una-Sana Canton a tourist tax is charged per person per night; the amount is set by cantonal regulations and can change. Children are usually exempt or pay a reduced rate, depending on age. The owner will confirm in reply to your enquiry whether the tax is already included in the price or paid to the host.

q: Do children pay tourist tax in Bihać?
a: In the Una-Sana Canton, children usually do not pay the tourist tax or pay a reduced rate; the age limit and amount depend on current cantonal regulations. The guest registration system calculates the tax based on each guest's age. As the rules can change, your host will confirm the exact amount for your family on arrival.

q: Do I have to show my passport or ID card to the host?
a: Yes, on arrival you show your host a passport or ID card for each guest, as accommodation providers in the Una-Sana Canton must register guests in the system within 24 hours of arrival. The host may not keep your document and only copies down the details. This way your stay is properly registered.

q: How do I collect the keys?
a: Usually you collect the keys in person from the owner or host on arrival, who will show you around the property. Check-in is from 12:00, and once your booking is confirmed you receive the address and the owner's contact details, so you can agree the exact time directly. A different key handover can be arranged for late arrivals. If you are delayed on the road or at the border, contact your host or us on WhatsApp or Viber +387 61 591 320.

q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
a: Check-in is from 12:00 and check-out is by 11:00. If the property is not booked after you, check-out can be as late as 12:00, which the owner will confirm a few days before or on the day of departure. If you are arriving late in the evening, mention it in your enquiry or on WhatsApp +387 61 591 320.

q: Are your properties in Bihać genuine and reliable?
a: All properties on apartmanibihac.com are real properties with known owners in and around Bihać. The Apartmani & Vikendice Facebook page has around 139,000 followers and 9,362 reviews, with 100 % recommending us. You can see photos and descriptions of the properties on the website and on Instagram @apartmaniivikendice.

q: Do you have accommodation for 10 or more people?
a: Yes, for 10 or more people we have Villa Mekić 2 for up to 20, Feel Luxury Apartments for up to 12, LUX Apartments Bihać for up to 10 and Vikendica Karakaš for 9 + 1. Farah Superior Apartments has two apartments, for 8 and 5 people. Per person, large houses are often the best-value option.

q: Do you have accommodation in Grmuša?
a: Yes, in Grmuša, about 20 km north-east of Bihać, we offer Green River and Vikendica Unadom, both sleeping 6 + 2, with access to the Una and a terrace over the river. Grmuša is one of the main rafting spots on the Una and home to the Una Olympic Rafting base. Send your dates at apartmanibihac.com or on WhatsApp +387 61 591 320.

q: Where to stay in Bihać for visiting Plitvice Lakes?
a: Any of our properties in Bihać works well for Plitvice, as the park entrance is about 35 km away, or 35 to 40 minutes' drive via Izačić. From the centre you get onto the road to the border quickest. A whole apartment with us starts at 25 € per night, which is usually less than accommodation right next to the park.

q: Where to stay near Štrbački Buk waterfall?
a: Our houses in Lohovo, south of Bihać, are closest to Una National Park, about 15 minutes from the entrance near Bihać. Vila Enio in Lohovo has a swimming pool and access to the Una. From the centre of Bihać, Štrbački Buk is also an easy half-day trip.

q: Do you have accommodation in Pritoka?
a: Yes, in Pritoka, right on the edge of Bihać, we offer Vikendica Rekić for up to 8 people, with access to the Una and a terrace over the river. The centre is a few minutes' drive away, so you have peace by the water with the town close by. Send your enquiry at apartmanibihac.com.

q: Are the houses on the Una safe for children?
a: The houses on the Una have access to the river, and the Una is cold even in summer and fast on the rapids, so children must be supervised at all times by the water. On calmer stretches, such as in Lohovo, getting into the water is easier. On arrival, ask your host where the safest place to swim is.

q: What should I bring to a holiday house on the Una?
a: For a house on the Una, bring swimwear, water shoes, insect repellent and warm clothes for the evening, as it can get cool by the river. Bed linen is included, but it is a good idea to bring towels for swimming in the river. If you plan a barbecue, check in your enquiry whether the property has one. It is best to buy groceries in Bihać before you arrive.

q: Can I book accommodation and rafting together?
a: Yes, we organise rafting with Una Olympic Rafting, which has its base in Grmuša and Salihovac and a restaurant by the river. Send an enquiry for a property and mention in your message that you would also like rafting, and you will receive a combined offer. Una Olympic Rafting also has mountain cabins for accommodation.

q: Do you speak English?
a: Yes, we speak English and German as well as Bosnian, so you can send your enquiry in English. You can write to us through the form on apartmanibihac.com, and we reply within 12 hours. For quick arrangements, message us on WhatsApp or Viber +387 61 591 320.

q: Is the accommodation available in winter?
a: Yes, some of our apartments in Bihać are available all year round, and prices are lowest in winter. For the houses on the Una, check in your enquiry whether they are open in winter and have heating. A winter stay suits those looking for peace and quiet and trips to see the frozen waterfalls.
